<details class="result-group" id="theorem-3-1-objective-level-argmin-statement" open>
<summary><span>Theorem 3.1 objective-level argmin statement</span><span class="result-count">3 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>$\hat{\beta} = \arg\min_b (Y - X b)'(Y - X b)$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-sumsquarederrors-olsbeta-le">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors_olsBeta_le</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 3.1 (existence half): <code>olsBeta X y</code> attains the minimum of the sum
of squared errors. For any coefficient vector <code>b</code>, <code>SSE(olsBeta X y) ≤ SSE(b)</code>.</p>
<p>Uniqueness — <code>b = olsBeta X y</code> whenever <code>SSE(b) = SSE(olsBeta X y)</code> — requires strict
positive-definiteness of <code>Xᵀ * X</code> and is left to a follow-up. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Fintype k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (X : Matrix n k Real)
  (y : n → Real) (b : k → Real) [inst_3 : Invertible (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul X.transpose X)],
  Real.instLE.le (HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors X y (HansenEconometrics.olsBeta X y))
    (HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors X y b)</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (2)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.olsBeta</code></li><li><code>HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors</code></li></ul></details>
<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter3LeastSquaresAlgebra.lean#L149">HansenEconometrics/Chapter3LeastSquaresAlgebra.lean:149</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-olsbeta-isminon">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.olsBeta_isMinOn</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 3.1 (existence half), packaged as <code>IsMinOn</code>: <code>olsBeta X y</code> is a
global minimizer of <code>sumSquaredErrors X y</code> over all of <code>k → ℝ</code>. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Fintype k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (X : Matrix n k Real)
  (y : n → Real) [inst_3 : Invertible (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul X.transpose X)],
  IsMinOn (HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors X y) Set.univ (HansenEconometrics.olsBeta X y)</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (2)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.olsBeta</code></li><li><code>HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors</code></li></ul></details>
<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter3LeastSquaresAlgebra.lean#L160">HansenEconometrics/Chapter3LeastSquaresAlgebra.lean:160</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-olsbeta-eq-of-minimizer">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.olsBeta_eq_of_minimizer</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 3.1 (uniqueness half): if <code>b</code> attains the minimum of the SSE, then
<code>b = olsBeta X y</code>. Combined with <code>sumSquaredErrors_olsBeta_le</code> and <code>olsBeta_isMinOn</code>,
this completes Hansen's Theorem 3.1: <code>olsBeta X y</code> is the unique minimizer of
<code>sumSquaredErrors X y</code> over <code>k → ℝ</code> whenever <code>Xᵀ * X</code> is invertible. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Fintype k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (X : Matrix n k Real)
  (y : n → Real) (b : k → Real) [inst_3 : Invertible (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul X.transpose X)],
  Eq (HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors X y b)
      (HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors X y (HansenEconometrics.olsBeta X y)) →
    Eq b (HansenEconometrics.olsBeta X y)</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (2)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.olsBeta</code></li><li><code>HansenEconometrics.sumSquaredErrors</code></li></ul></details>

<details class="result-group" id="theorem-3-7-leave-one-out-regression">

<div class="result-body">

<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 3.7 / equation (3.43): leave-one-out coefficients can be
computed from the full-sample coefficient and prediction error. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Fintype k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (X : Matrix n k Real)

  [inst_4 : Invertible (HansenEconometrics.leaveOneOutGram X i)],
  Eq (HansenEconometrics.leaveOneOutBeta X y i)
    (instHSub.hSub (HansenEconometrics.olsBeta X y)
      (instHSMul.hSMul (HansenEconometrics.leaveOneOutResidual X y i)
